What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number never updates or shows no movement, it’s often because the carrier hasn’t scanned the package yet. Tracking labels can be created before the carrier physically picks up the shipment, which can delay visible updates.
Here are a few things you can do:
Check your email (including spam/junk) for the tracking notification.
Log into your account and review the tracking details in your order.
Use the carrier’s tracking page (for example, UPS) to check for updates.
Refresh the tracking page after the shipment is dispatched, as updates may appear later.
If tracking still hasn’t appeared after 7–10 business days, it may mean the package hasn’t been handed to the carrier yet or the vendor is still processing the shipment.
